children: International Media Acquisition made a $2,000 deposit to extend its business combination deadline to November 2, 2026.
Filed notice that Applicable Deadline extended from Oct. 2, 2026 to Nov. 2, 2026 to consummate a business combination.
Authorized and wired a $2,000 Extension Payment into the trust account as required by the Trust Agreement.
This notice constitutes the 22nd of the twenty-four Extension Letters under the Trust Agreement.
Extension is made pursuant to Section 1(j) of the Investment Management Trust Agreement with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust.
